ROLLING STONE & MALCOLM TODD
INTERVIEWS CLIPPING
Clipping Campaign Guidelines | Powered by creatorXchange
Campaign Malcolm Todd Interviews Clipping
Platforms TikTok / Instagram Reels
CPM $2.00
Page Type ONLY MUSIC, GENERAL ENTERTAINMENT CULTURE, PODCAST & MEME
PAGES ALLOWED
*Clips MUST be trimmed from official Malcolm Todd interviews only.
CAMPAIGN GOAL
Clip and circulate moments from Malcolm Todd's interviews — across any official interview, podcast, or
press appearance — highlighting his personality, artistry, and breakout year. Malcolm is having a huge
run right now with "Earrings," his top 5 album Do That Again, and a sold-out headline tour, on top of
"Chest Pain" continuing to blow up. Clips should build hype around Malcolm as an artist and give fans a
reason to go deeper into his interviews.
CONTENT IDEAS & VISUAL ANGLES FOR TRIMMING
● Standout quotes about his come-up, influences, or creative process
● Funny, candid, or personality-driven moments — these perform especially well on meme pages
● Any moment he talks about "Chest Pain," "Earrings," or Do That Again
● Him discussing his sold-out headline tour or the live show experience
● Moments where he reacts to his own success or virality
● Behind-the-scenes, freestyle, or off-the-cuff moments if present in the interview
● Any clip that shows a different side of him than fans typically see
SUGGESTED TEXT-ON-SCREEN
● "Malcolm Todd is having the biggest year of his career"
● "This is why everyone's obsessed with Malcolm Todd right now"
● "Malcolm Todd on how 'Chest Pain' changed his life"
● "The making of Do That Again"
● "Malcolm Todd just sold out his first headline tour"
● "He's funnier than you'd expect"
● "Malcolm Todd speaks facts in this one"
● "This interview proves Malcolm Todd is different"
● "Malcolm Todd's rise, in his own words"
● "He wasn't even trying to blow up like this"
● "The most real Malcolm Todd interview yet"
CAMPAIGN RULES
● ONLY MUSIC, ENTERTAINMENT CULTURE, PODCAST & MEME PAGES ALLOWED
● Clips MUST be trimmed from official Malcolm Todd interviews only
● Videos must be original edits, not reposted or stolen from other clippers
● Don't misquote or take clips out of context in a way that misrepresents Malcolm
● TikTok and Instagram Reels only
